shapes_text.text: TRAVELMATE

"Don't just find a ticket. Find the journey."
AI-powered multimodal travel planning + journey safety
🚆 Train | 🚌 Bus | ✈️ Flight | 🤖 AI | 🚨 Safety
National Startup Pitch Competition 2026  ·  Surendra Gedala
Travel Gets Complicated When There's No Direct Route
No Direct Train
Travelers are left stranded with no single-mode solution between origin and destination.
Bus Too Slow, Flight Too Expensive
Neither extreme fits. The optimal path lies somewhere in between — and no platform finds it.
Manual Multi-Platform Search
Travelers jump across IRCTC, RedBus, MakeMyTrip — manually stitching together a journey themselves.
Disruptions Handled Separately
Once traveling, emergencies and disruptions are managed through entirely disconnected tools.
Too many decisions. Too many platforms. The traveler does the work that technology should.
Travelers Don't Want a Ticket.
They Want to Reach the Destination.
The insight that drives everything TravelMate does.
Traditional Travel Search
"What transportation is available from A?"
Platforms present options by mode — train results, bus results, flight results — and leave the traveler to figure out the rest.
The TravelMate Question
"What is the best practical way to get this traveler from A to B?"
A fundamental shift: from individual ticket search to complete journey intelligence. The AI works backward from the destination, not forward from a departure board.
TravelMate's AI Figures Out the Journey
Direct Route Check
Verify single-mode availability and suitability.
Multimodal Generation
Create combined options like Train+Flight or Bus+Flight.
Journey Scoring
Score by time, cost, transfers, buffers, preferences.
Ranked Output
Return fastest, cheapest, and balanced choices.
Live availability and pricing require verified provider/API integrations.
From Destination Request to Complete Journey
How the Engine Works

The traveler simply states where they want to go. TravelMate handles the complexity underneath.
Live availability and pricing require verified provider/API integrations.
1. User Input
Origin, destination, date, budget, and preferences.
2. Direct Route Check
Is a suitable single-mode option available?
3. Multimodal Generation
If no direct route, AI constructs combinations.
4. Ranked Output
Fastest, cheapest, and balanced journeys presented clearly.
One Journey, One Interface
PLAN
Train, bus, flight, and multimodal routes. All journeys saved under My Trips in one place.
ASSIST
AI travel assistant with personalized recommendations, voice assistance, and multilingual journey guidance.
PROTECT
Safety Mode, SOS, live location sharing, emergency contacts, and offline emergency resources — always accessible.
TravelMate stays useful before, during, and when something goes wrong.
Travel Assistance Shouldn't Stop After Booking
Most platforms end their job at confirmation. TravelMate stays with the traveler throughout the journey — especially when things go wrong.
Safety Mode Features
Emergency messages require user confirmation before sending.
SOS & Emergency Contact
One-tap access to 112 and pre-set emergency contacts with location sharing.
Scenario-Specific Guidance
Step-by-step assistance for medical emergencies, theft/robbery, and lost passport situations.
Offline Emergency Pack
Automatic low-network fallback with locally cached journey and emergency information for connectivity gaps.
Planning → Travelling → Safety
A single continuous experience across every stage of the journey.
PLAN
Tell TravelMate where you want to go.
AI ROUTE
Find a direct or multimodal journey automatically.
CHOOSE
Select based on time, cost, and convenience.
MY TRIP
Keep the complete journey together in one view.
TRAVEL
Get contextual AI assistance throughout the journey.
SAFETY
If something goes wrong, activate Safety Mode instantly.
From Ticket Search to Journey Intelligence
TRADITIONAL PLATFORMS
How Travel Was Searched
Mode-by-Mode Search
Train results. Bus results. Flight results. Separate, siloed, disconnected.
Manual Journey Assembly
The traveler figures out connections, timing gaps, and transfers themselves.
Booking-Focused
Platform value ends at confirmation. No journey context beyond the ticket.
Emergency Assistance Separate
Safety tools are entirely outside the travel platform.
TRAVELMATE
How Journeys Are Intelligently Orchestrated
AI Constructs Complete Journeys
Train + Bus + Flight combinations generated and ranked automatically.
Multimodal by Design
Every combination evaluated: time, cost, transfers, connection buffers, preferences.
Journey-Focused with Context AI
The platform stays relevant from planning through arrival.
Integrated Safety Mode
Emergency assistance built into the same interface. Always one tap away.
Differentiation: Intelligently orchestrating multiple modes into one complete journey — not just aggregating tickets.
India's Digital Travel Market Is Large — and Still Growing
India's online travel market is estimated at $25.38B in 2026 and forecast to reach $38.58B by 2031, an 8.74% CAGR. Transportation is the largest service category.

Go-To-Market & Business Model
PHASE 1 — Student & Young Travelers
College communities, WhatsApp groups, Instagram, student ambassadors
PHASE 2 — Product-Led Growth
Core shareable experience: "Find the best way from A → B"
PHASE 3 — Ecosystem Partnerships
Transport providers, travel agencies, universities, corporate travel, tourism organizations
Planned revenue streams: booking commissions, affiliate partnerships, premium AI/safety features, and B2B travel technology. These are planned — not current revenue.
